svg.text: an on-call engineer that has to prove its work: detect, diagnose, fix, prove
captured request/response pairs at the edge
LAMPLIGHTER WORKER: DURABLE STATE MACHINE, EVERY STEP SAFE TO REPEAT
accepted only if all required pass
exactly one, else a human decides
only if it cites real evidence and
its numbers appear in that evidence
written to a file, never deployed
cannot choose or trigger an action
everything works with it switched off
Numbers 1 to 8 are the steps of an incident, in order. Any step that cannot be proven ends in ESCALATED with the evidence attached.
